brief_summary: Our general aim is to investigate whether messenger RNA (mRNA) and/or microRNA (miRNA) expression profiles in white blood cells, predict metformin monotherapy efficacy in patients with type 2 diabetes.
brief_title: Gene Expression Profiles and Metformin Efficacy in Type 2 Diabetes

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes (duration of diabetes of at least 2 years)
* age 40-70 yrs
* HbA1c \> 6.4 \< 9.0

Exclusion Criteria:

* insulin therapy
* contraindications to metformin use

official_title: White Blood Cells Gene Expression Profiles as a Tool for Predicting Metformin Efficacy in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

primary_outcomes.measure: Fasting glucose change after metformin treatment in respect to mRNA and miRNA expression profiles in white blood cells
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Baseline and after three months of metfomin therapy
